resolution.schema: IIPS_INVESTMENT_FUNDAMENTALS_V3 requires the binding on every nil cell; V1 and V2 keep the legacy grammar and their recorded meaning, byte for byte
checks: section must equal the item's own statement (BS|PNL|CF)
class must equal the item's class in a closed, total table over the line-item reference table
scope must be declared; when it differs from the row's statement scope the declaration is legal only with acceptedBy, which is stored on the observation
unknown, duplicate or missing binding members are refused (never guessed)
resolution.failClosed: any binding ERROR means the cell is not a nil: it becomes MISSING / NOT_REPORTED and the ingest exits non-zero, so the mapping cannot reach a dataset, payload or persisted version
resolution.recorded: a valid binding is stored on the observation as nilBinding and is therefore published in the payload beside the quote
resolution.reviewStep: source/review-record.json applies the grammar to the four declarations Work Item 3 made before it existed, and records the acceptance of each, including the one cross-scope mapping
resolution.whatItCannotDo: read English. A false declaration is now a recorded, falsifiable claim rather than an unchecked omission; the semantic reading stays a review responsibility, tied to acceptedBy and to the per-issuer evidence bundle.

accepted.why: the group states it has no outstanding borrowings; the component is a member of that class, presented on the balance sheet, at the same scope
current maturities are a component of borrowings

completionStandard.scopeStatement: Under V1 and V2 an unbound nil remains legal, because those datasets mean what they always meant and are not re-digested. V3 is the schema that closes the hole for new data, exactly as V2 was the schema that made an associates/JV carrying value representable.
